messages:
Maya Chen: Heads-up — courier is at the main lobby with 3 boxes and a fragile plant. They're asking for a recipient to sign.
Front Desk: Thanks Maya. Can someone confirm which desk/recipient for each box? I have "Package 1: 'Ben L.'", "Package 2: 'Conference supplies'", "Package 3: 'Fragile - Maya Chen (plant)'".
Tomas: I'm around — can pick up Ben's. Leaving in 5m.
Izzy: I'll take conference supplies to 3rd floor meeting room B and set them by the AV cart.
Maya Chen: @Front Desk yes please mark package 3 as 'fragile - keep upright' and put it in the green locker. I'll grab it on my way in.
Front Desk: Roger. Lockers: code F2B, put fragile in slot #07.
ops-bot: Package scanned: PCK-874321 assigned to Front Desk locker F2B/#07. ETA to pick-up: 20m.
Ben L.: Thanks Tomas! Leaving my badge at the desk — pick-up OK.
Lila: Quick question: the two visiting contractors are arriving early and were promised the couch in the community area. Can someone swap the hotdesk seat?
Tomas: I can move to a quiet corner for the morning. Ben — can you leave the couch free after 10:30? :slightly_smiling_face:
Ben L.: Yep - leaving it free after 10:30.
Izzy: Poll? couch vs booth for contractors. React with :couch: for couch, :chair: for booth.
Maya Chen: :couch:
Tomas: :chair:
Lila: :couch:
Front Desk: Contractors also need visitor badges; please add names to the visitor list in the kiosk or DM me.
Maya Chen: Dropping their names in now — @Front Desk check-in under 'Redwood Partner — S. Rivera, K. Patel'.
ops-bot: Visitor badges created: V-10071, V-10072.
Front Desk: All set. Couriers signed out. Plant marked fragile and stored. Thanks team!
